## ChatOSS v1.2.0

### New Features
- **Agents Settings tab**: A new tab in Settings holds all agent-related settings — Default effort level, Default Code mode, orchestrator settings, and complexity-based model selection.
- **Complexity-based sub-agent model auto-selection**: When enabled in Settings, the orchestrator automatically picks each sub-agent's model based on task complexity (Low/Medium/High), using models you map per complexity tier.
- **Effort level per complexity tier**: Set not just the model but also the reasoning effort (Low/Medium/High/Max) for each complexity tier, giving fine-grained control over cost vs. quality.

### Bug Fixes
- **Orchestrator worktree-review bug**: Fixed an issue where the orchestrator would check the main branch instead of sub-agent worktrees for changes, falsely reporting sub-agents as failed.
- **Sub-agent confusion bug**: Sub-agents now receive a mandatory directive to make actual edits, preventing them from seeing pre-existing git changes and incorrectly declaring tasks "already done."
- **Auto-move Kanban cards**: Strengthened the orchestrator prompt to always pass card_id when spawning sub-agents, so cards automatically move to In Progress/In Review.
